title: Embroidered Sun and Waves Beanie, Minimalist Ocean Cuffed Beanie, Beach Lover Gift, Knit Winter Hat for Women and Men
description:
A little golden sun rising over blue waves, embroidered on the cuff of a classic knit beanie. Minimal, warm and easy to wear every day, for everyone who misses the sea in winter.

DETAILS
- Embroidered design on the cuff (not printed)
- 100% soft acrylic knit, hypoallergenic
- Classic 12 in (30 cm) cuffed beanie, stretchy, one size fits most adults
- Colours: Red, Navy, Black, Olive

CARE
Hand wash cold, lay flat to dry. Do not iron the embroidery.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Embroidered on demand by our production partner and shipped with tracking. Orders to the USA are made in the USA, orders to Europe are made in Europe. Production takes 2-5 business days.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
